formData.name: powerstatus
formData.transform:
|
  <%
    _.chain(DATA?.list ?? [])
        .map(v => ({...v, groupId: `${v.snmp_netware_power_name}_${v.snmp_netware_power_index}`}))
        .groupBy('groupId')
        .mapValues(items => _.maxBy(items, 'time'))
        .values()
        .thru(v => ({
          total: v.length,
          normal: _.sumBy(v, o => _.cond([
            [
              instance => /ruijie|锐捷/i.test(instance?.cBrand || instance?.brand || ''),
              () => o.powerstatus === 4
            ],
            [
              _.stubTrue,
              () => o.powerstatus === 1 // 其他品牌默认 1=正常
            ]
          ])(CTX.DS.instance) ? 1 : 0)
        }))
        .thru(v => _.cond([
            [x => !x.total, _.constant(({text: "未知", style: "card-status-dot card-status-dot--error"}))],
            [x => x.normal === x.total, _.constant(({text: "全部正常", style: "card-status-dot card-status-dot--normal"}))],
            [x => x.normal === 0, _.constant(({text: "全部异常", style: "card-status-dot card-status-dot--error"}))],
            [x => x.normal !== x.total, _.constant(({text: "部分异常", style: "card-status-dot card-status-dot--warning"}))],
            [_.stubTrue, _.constant(({text: "未知", style: "card-status-dot card-status-dot--error"}))]
        ])(v))
        .value()
  %>

containerStyle:
  gridGap: 4px

useBrick:
  # 标题
  - brick: div
    properties:
      classList: [ card-label ]
      style:
        fontSize: 18px
        fontWeight: 700
        marginBottom: 10px
      textContent: 端口列表

  # 包裹层：控制横向 & 纵向溢出都隐藏
  - brick: div
    properties:
      style:
        width: 100%
        display: flex
        flexDirection: column
        overflowX: hidden
        overflowY: hidden
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: presentational-bricks.brick-table
            properties:
              columns:
                - dataIndex: snmp_netware_device_ifname
                  key: snmp_netware_device_ifname
                  title: 名称
                  useBrick:
                    brick: div
                    properties:
                      style:
                        display: flex
                        alignItems: center 
                        gap: 6px
                        flexWrap: wrap
                        whiteSpace: normal
                        wordBreak: break-all
                        lineHeight: 1.5
                    slots:
                      items:
                        bricks:
                          - brick: presentational-bricks.basic-icon
                            properties:
                              icon:
                                lib: fa
                                icon: ethernet
                                prefix: fas
                                color: var(--theme-blue-color)
                              size: 15px
                              style:
                                marginTop: 1px    
                          - brick: span
                            properties:
                              style:
                                flex: 1
                                wordBreak: break-all
                                whiteSpace: normal
                              textContent: <% DATA.cellData %>
                - dataIndex: ifspeed
                  key: ifspeed
                  title: 预估带宽(Gbps)
                  useBrick:
                    brick: span
                    properties:
                      textContent: '<% _.round(DATA.cellData / 1000) %>'
                - dataIndex: in_speed
                  key: in_speed
                  title: 每秒入流量(Mbps)
                  useBrick:
                    brick: span
                    properties:
                      textContent: '<% _.round(DATA.cellData*8/1000**2, 2) %>'
                - dataIndex: out_speed
                  key: out_speed
                  title: 每秒出流量(Mbps)
                  useBrick:
                    brick: span
                    properties:
                      textContent: '<% _.round(DATA.cellData*8/1000**2, 2) %>'
                - dataIndex: ifouterrors
                  key: ifinerrors
                  title: 每秒入错误包(个)
                  useBrick:
                    brick: span
                    properties:
                      textContent: <% DATA.cellData %>
                      style: |
                        <%
                          _.cond([
                            [v => v > 10, _.constant({ color: '#E57373', fontWeight: 'bold' })],
                            [v => v > 0, _.constant({ color: '#FFB74D', fontWeight: 'bold' })],
                            [_.stubTrue, _.constant({ color: 'inherit', fontWeight: 'normal' })]
                          ])(DATA.cellData)
                        %>
                      
                - dataIndex: ifouterrors
                  key: ifouterrors
                  title: 每秒出错误包(个)
                  useBrick:
                    brick: span
                    properties:
                      textContent: <% DATA.cellData %>
                      style: |
                        <%
                          _.cond([
                            [v => v > 10, _.constant({ color: '#E57373', fontWeight: 'bold' })],
                            [v => v > 0, _.constant({ color: '#FFB74D', fontWeight: 'bold' })],
                            [_.stubTrue, _.constant({ color: 'inherit', fontWeight: 'normal' })]
                          ])(DATA.cellData)
                        %>
                - dataIndex: operstatus
                  key: operstatus
                  title: 端口状态
                  useBrick:
                    brick: presentational-bricks.brick-conditional-display
                    properties:
                      dataSource:
                        ifoperstatus: <% CTX.DS.ifoperstatus[DATA.rowData.snmp_netware_device_ifname] %>
                      rules:
                        - condition:
                            ifoperstatus: 1
                          label: 在线(Up)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#C8E6C9'
                            color: '#256029'

                        - condition:
                            ifoperstatus: 2
                          label: 离线(Down)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#FFCDD2'
                            color: '#B71C1C'

                        - condition:
                            ifoperstatus: 3
                          label: 测试中(Testing)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#FFF9C4'
                            color: '#795548'

                        - condition:
                            ifoperstatus: 5
                          label: 下层未启用(LowerLayerDown)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#BBDEFB'
                            color: '#0D47A1'

                        - condition:
                            ifoperstatus: 6
                          label: 管理关闭(Dormant)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#E0E0E0'
                            color: '#424242'

                        - condition:
                            $or:
                              - ifoperstatus: 7
                              - ifoperstatus: null
                              - $and:
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 1 }
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 2 }
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 3 }
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 5 }
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 6 }
                                  - ifoperstatus: { $ne: 7 }
                          label: 未知状态(Unknown)
                          style:
                            backgroundColor: '#D7CCC8'
                            color: '#3E2723'

              scrollConfigs:
                y: 430px

    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:

            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]

    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 型号
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              textContent: <% CTX.DS.instance.mdl %>

  # 序列号
  - brick: div
    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 序列号
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              textContent: <% CTX.DS.instance.sn %>

    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 软件版本

            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              textContent: <% _.get(CTX.DS.instance, "sysVersion") %>

  - brick: div
    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 管理IP
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              style:
                color: var(--theme-blue-color)
              textContent: <% CTX.DS.instance.ip %>
  # 端口数量
  - brick: div
    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 端口数量
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              textContent: <% _.chain(CTX.DS.ifoperstatus).keys().value().length %>
  - brick: div
    properties:
      classList: [ info-row ]
    slots:
      items:
        bricks:
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-label ]
              textContent: 正常运行时间
          - brick: span
            properties:
              classList: [ info-value ]
              textContent: |
                <%
                  _.chain(moment.duration(_.get(CTX.DS.uptime, "[0].snmp_netware_uptime"), 'seconds'))
                  .thru(d => ({
                    d: d.days(),
                    h: d.hours(),
                    m: d.minutes(),
                    s: d.seconds()
                  }))
                  .thru(v =>
                    _.compact([
                      v.d ? v.d + '天' : '',
                      v.h ? v.h + '小时' : '',
                      v.m ? v.m + '分' : '',
                      (!v.d && !v.h && !v.m ? v.s + '秒' : (v.s ? v.s + '秒' : ''))
                    ]).join('')
                  )
                  .value()
                %>
